fields.value: Supplementary data for "Texture Descriptors Ensembles Enable Image-Based Classification of Maturation of Human Stem Cell-Derived Retinal Pigmented Epithelium"

dsDescriptionValue.value: The RPE dataset contains 1862 subwindows from 195 phase contrast images. Each RPE cell culture was imaged with the same settings. The microscope used was a Nikon Eclipse TE200S phase-contrast microscope (Nikon Instruments Europe B.V., Amstelveen, Netherlands) with the 20x objective and Ph1 phase contrast.

publicationCitation.value: Texture descriptors ensembles enable image-based classification of maturation of human stem cell-derived retinal pigmented epithelium
